request.description: Public deployment-readiness probe. HTTP 200 means bootstrap completed; HTTP 503 means startup is pending or failed. This does not continuously ping external providers.

ADVISORY dependency probe. Runs bounded Firestore / Gemini / TradingView MCP / Binance / Telegram probes in parallel. Alert on `ready: false`; use `GET /ready?depth=dependencies` when you want a traffic-gating 503.

Protected status request exposing notificationChannelIntent, the operator-intent view of channel configuration (GH-713). It mirrors NotificationChannel.isConfigured(): a channel counts as configured when its enable flag is set AND its required credentials/chat id/webhook are present. A channel with credentials present but its enable flag off reports as not configured, matching the zero-channel admin page because both call the same method. Separates channels the operator never set up from ones that are set up but currently failing, so an operator can answer 'why did I get the zero-channel page?' without inspecting credentials. Channel names only; no credentials or destinations are exposed.

request.description: Every protected /api response carries the standard X-RateLimit-* headers so callers can implement adaptive backpressure. The webhook ingest endpoints use an isolated 1,000-request bucket; ordinary /api endpoints use RATE_LIMIT_MAX.
